svg.title: GridRag intelligent notifications — proposed architecture
svg.desc: Save a customer’s alert query, run it on a schedule, check the results, and send an alert or take an approved action. MCP is optional. Check for database changes daily.
svg.text: Tell us what to watch. We’ll keep an eye on it.
Create a query. Check the grid. Alert or act.
“Notify me when ERCOT prices exceed $200/MWh for 15 minutes while wind output falls.”
Set up once. Update when the rule or database changes.
What to watch and who to notify
Find the right tables and columns
Repeat on the customer’s schedule—for example, every five minutes.
When the condition matches, send an alert or take an approved action.
Include the results and why it fired
Ask the user first when required
If they change, update and retest the affected queries.
Also check when a query fails.
Check data freshness on every run.
Keep most of the prompt the same so it can be cached.
Actual savings depend on cache reuse.
Simple rules can skip the model.
MCP is optional. Direct APIs work too.
